objective: Teach ORION/VLM to interpret frozen task-agnostic spatial observation UQ, predict an explicit task-relevance map, and produce map-consistent QA explanations before any trajectory optimization.

task_relevance.prediction_source: VLM-fused hidden states at UQ token positions

data_gates.interface_smoke: one development event; no scientific claim

evaluation_gates: held-out route/event dense relevance BCE and ranking
on-path UQ must increase K more than equal-strength off-path UQ
zero-UQ and irrelevant-UQ hard negatives must not produce conservative language by default
structured QA answer must agree with dense R and K sidecars
unseen Town and unseen scenario-family slices are reported separately
stage2p_entry: Only after Stage2-L semantic, counterfactual and leakage gates pass. Stage2-P first freezes VLM/relevance and trains the trajectory decoder, then permits a constrained low-learning-rate joint phase if necessary.
retired_initialization: The old standalone spatial_task_fusion/Stage2A checkpoint is diagnostic only and must not initialize this path.
